title: Linked Movements · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Linked Movements · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose two players and agree on three small, safe gestures. The pair alternates performing the three gestures in the agreed order. All three gestures occur in order without overlap. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Linked Movements, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
All three gestures occur in order without overlap.
recall.why: All three gestures occur in order without overlap.
